body.x: A-WORKS (CEO Jang Min, www.aworks.io) showcased its “‘A-BLOCK”, an IoT-based smart device, in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).
A-BLOCK is a secondary smart device that controls IoT products by using an IFTTT platform.

It can be automatically connected to the Internet via Wi-Fi without an additional linking device. It can use or control not only smart devices but also smartphones and Web services via the six buttons that are embedded.
Its design reminds people of Apple and Xiaomi. Also, it has increased user convenience by allowing them to check the input of the buttons through LED and a speaker embedded on each button.

A-WORKS CEO Jang Min said: “We will launch this product on Kickstarter, a crowdfunding site, this month. We will promote the creativity of our product to the global market, including the American market, through CES 2016.”

The company is an IoT device developer and is focusing on the home networking market, which makes life more convenient. It will establish itself as a global brand by participating in CES 2016 and attracting crowdfunding investors. It will conduct various marketing activities and is planning to start its business on Amazon in the near future.

MTCC prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the smart venture school Kyungpook National University. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
